post.text: This is Juniper. She's a Bernese Mountain Dog puppy who spent her days pawing at the kennel window, dreaming of a family. Today she got one complete with two excited boys for nonstop hugs. Pure happiness. adopt don't shop ❤️ https://t.co/tHUKVMHvXL
post.author_description: Your Original source for Original Dog Video

description.description: A series of frames showing a Saint Bernard dog being reunited with its family. In the first and second frames, the large dog is peering through a small window built into an orange door at an animal facility. In the third and fourth frames, the dog is joyfully greeting and being petted by a group consisting of three young children and two adults inside a room.

tweetMedia.transcription: Is this for you? Is this for you? Did you just get adopted? You did sweetie, you just got adopted. Yes, you did. I'll pass this to you. Thank you. You enjoy your new life, okay? Okay. Thank you guys so much again. Thank you.
